name: Voisin C14 1929
description:
Avions Voisin C14 - the 1929 car of the Musée Auto Moto Vélo de Châtellerault (inv. 91.2.2), scanned by Digiscan 3D for Alienor.org. Gabriel Voisin built aeroplanes until 1918, then cars for the celebrities of the twenties; the C14 was his great car of the early thirties, 1795 built at Issy-les-Moulineaux. 2327 cc Knight double sleeve-valve straight six, Zenith carburettor, Dynastart: 60 hp at 3,000 rpm; 3-speed gearbox with Voisin's 2-speed transfer box (6 forward); beam axle and live axle on semi-elliptic leaves; four drums with Dewandre vacuum servo; 32 x 6 tyres on wire wheels; aluminium body; 1,250 kg. Right-hand drive.

3D model: "Automobile Voisin C14" by Alienor.org, Conseil des musées (CC BY-NC-ND 4.0) - https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/automobile-voisin-c14-ae942f7b97c64e898f620e2b59215d49
